description: Rename a function, signal, variable, class_name, autoload, input action, group or node name everywhere it is used (GDScript, scene connections, node paths, groups, project settings), or move a res:// file together with its .uid and .import files and every reference to it. `from` and `to` are both names or both res:// paths. Without `write` it changes nothing and returns the exact lines it would change and what it could not change; with `write: true` it applies them and reports the review errors before and after (an error result when there are more after). Refuses, with an error, when the new name is already taken. Call godot_usages first to see what it will touch. For a setting value, an input event or a node property, use godot_project_edit or godot_scene_edit instead.

from.description: the current name, or a res:// path

path.description: project folder, or a file or folder inside it (relative to the server's folder; default: the current project)

to.description: the new name, or the new res:// path

write.description: apply the rename (default false: show the plan only)

name: godot_rename
title: Rename everywhere
